title: Aggrega Internal Template Context
description:
The runtime view assembled by the Go compiler and injected into Recipe and FeatureRecipe Go templates during Step 5. For credential FeatureRecipes (implementing Features labeled feature.aggrega.ai/kind: secret), the compiler additionally populates .secret_name and .inject with the secret-specific context. For boundary-scope FeatureRecipes (spec.executionScope: boundary), the .context, .workload, .secret_name, .inject, and .inject_raw pillars are absent and a .boundary.* pillar is populated instead — see the boundary block at the bottom of properties. This is NOT persisted to disk; it exists only in compiler memory during rendering. This schema documents the contract between the compiler and Ops template authors.

Phase B sub-pass availability:
  Pass 1 (provides): partial pillars (self-ref banned).
  Phase B.0 (locals + source eval): all pillars; .source and .workload absent.
  Phase B.1 (valuesMapping): all pillars + .source; .workload absent.
  Phase B.2 (workload eval): all pillars + .source; .workload being evaluated (absent from self-reference).
  Phase B.3 (artifacts): all pillars + .source + .workload (fullest context).

context.description: The compiler-assembled execution context providing identity, topology, and delivery data.

instance_id.description: The absolute flattened ID of the current node (e.g., 'backend' or 'data-layer.main-db'). Deterministic and stable across compilations for the same Aggregate.

labels.description: The duck-typing and ontology labels of the current node, including any mutations applied by mutator.wasm in Step 2.

annotations.description: The three cascading annotation buckets for the current node, segregated by origin.

release.description: Physical topology strings cascading from Release boundaries.

catalog.description: Immutable intrinsic traits authored by the Platform Architect in Domain 2.

aggregate.description: Cognitive metadata cascading from Aggregate subsystems.

inject.description: The pre-hydrated and intercepted delivery pipe. Starts as a compiler-generated map resolving Developer inject keys to Target provides values. Mutated in-place by Phase A injectMapping deep-merges. By the time the Base Recipe renders in Phase B, this contains the fully resolved physical strings.

env.description: Environment variable delivery. Keys are the Developer's local variable names, values are the resolved target strings.

file.description: File mount delivery. Keys are local file paths, values are the resolved target strings.

arg.description: Command-line argument delivery. Keys are flag prefixes, values are the resolved target strings.

all.description: Pre-calculated flat merge of env + file + arg + custom mechanisms. Populated after Pass 2b and recalculated after Phase A. Templates use {{ toJson .context.inject.all }} for universal serialization.

additionalProperties.description: Custom injection paradigms (e.g., 'ssm_param'). Open-ended per the inject schema's additionalProperties.

uses.description: The enriched topological edge map. Keyed by the Developer's alias (e.g., 'my_db', 'my_api'). Each entry is a compiler-assembled view of the target node's identity, resolved provides, injection mapping, and cascaded annotations. This is NOT the raw IR edge — it is an enriched projection built by the compiler specifically for template consumption.

values.description: The opaque cognitive payload for this node, already validated by the schema validator in Step 1. Passed through untouched.

infra.description: The physical sizing payload injected from the Release for this node. Bypasses the Developer entirely.

locals.description: The Recipe's own private state (e.g., primary_compute, volumes_path). Available for self-referencing within valuesMapping, provides templates, and for downstream Wasm plugins via pipeline[].with blocks. Never exposed to callers.

provides.description: The Recipe's public API contract. Populated from Pass 1 evaluation. Available in Phase B valuesMapping for self-reference (e.g., {{ .provides.host }}). NOT available within the provides template itself (Pass 1 self-containment invariant). Callers resolve inject keys against these values.

features.description: The attached features for this node, keyed by instance name. Available for Base Recipes to conditionally adapt rendering based on attached capabilities.

secrets.description: The attached credential Features for this node, keyed by instance name.

type.description: The Catalog credential Feature URI (labeled feature.aggrega.ai/kind: secret).

metadata.description: Release and compilation metadata providing global identity for deterministic naming. Available in all template blocks (valuesMapping, injectMapping, pipeline with).

release_name.description: The name of the Release driving this deployment (e.g., 'prod-billing'). Used by Ops to construct globally unique cloud resource names (S3 buckets, IAM roles). Combined with .context.instance_id to guarantee uniqueness across environments.

release_version.description: The semantic version of the Release.

environment.description: The environment string from the Release metadata (e.g., 'production', 'local').

aggregate_name.description: The name of the root Aggregate being compiled.

secret_name.description: Only populated when rendering a credential FeatureRecipe. Contains the logical secret key name from the Component's secretsSchema or the Developer's secrets: block (e.g., 'admin_password', 'db_credentials'). Used to construct deterministic physical secret names (e.g., '{{ .context.instance_id }}-{{ .secret_name }}').

inject.description: Only populated when rendering a credential FeatureRecipe. Contains the secret-specific inject block from the Developer's secrets entry (e.g., { env: { OPENAI_API_KEY: 'api_token' } }). Distinct from .context.inject which is the base component's pre-hydrated delivery pipe from uses edges. Evaluates to null/absent for non-credential FeatureRecipes and base Recipes.

all.description: Compiler-generated convenience merge of all secret inject paradigms.

inject_raw.description: The immutable, unmutated Developer intent for the inject block. Evaluates to null if the Developer omitted the inject block entirely. Used by Ops for logical checks (e.g., {{ if not .inject_raw }}) to detect omission before Phase A mutations.

steps.description: Pipeline inter-step communication. Only available inside Wasm pipeline 'with:' blocks. Each key is a pipeline step ID, containing the outputs exported by that step.

source.description: Resolved source field content. Populated at Phase B.0 from the Recipe's source: field after Go-template evaluation. Available in Phase B.1+ (valuesMapping, workload, artifacts). Evaluates to null when the Recipe has no source:. String form = URI path; object form = structured source (e.g., OCI descriptor with resolved version).

workload.description: Parsed Workload spec for this node. Populated at Phase B.2 from the Recipe's workload: / workloadFrom: field after Go-template evaluation + Workload JSON-schema validation (against workload-v1alpha1.schema.json). Available in Phase B.3+ (artifacts) so artifacts can reference workload fields without duplication (e.g., a ServiceMonitor reading .workload.services.metrics.ports.prom). Evaluates to null when the Recipe has no workload: or workloadFrom:. Template attempts to dereference .workload.* on a null value fail with a clear error at template eval time.

boundary.description: Boundary-scope context — populated only when evaluating a FeatureRecipe whose spec.executionScope is 'boundary'. Component-scope FRs do not receive this pillar; their context.instance_id, context.inject, context.uses, and the .workload pillar carry per-component data instead. Boundary-scope FRs receive .boundary.* in place of those per-component pillars.

path.description: The boundary's evaluated directory path (post-template-evaluation). Same string used for per-(path, provider) dispatch grouping at orchestrator-time.

boundary_name.description: The boundary's name (the map key in release.spec.boundaries).

components.description: Map of instance_id to ComponentInfo for every component in the boundary's subtree (recursive, includes nested-boundary components). Each entry carries the component's resolved type URI, instance ID, and provided values from per-component provides evaluation.

internal_uses_edges.description: Uses edges where source AND target are both in this boundary's subtree.

outgoing_cross_boundary_uses_edges.description: Uses edges where source is in subtree, target is outside. Used by compose-bridge: which outbound connections need the bridge to proxy.

incoming_cross_boundary_uses_edges.description: Uses edges where target is in subtree, source is outside. Used by ingress-style aggregators that need to know who's calling in.

cross_boundary_uses_edges.description: Convenience union of outgoing and incoming cross-boundary edges.

labels.description: Union of components' labels in the subtree, with author-order preservation.

annotations.description: The boundary's own annotations after the cascade resolves.

feature_attachments.description: List of features directly attached to this boundary (for cross-feature reference within boundary scope).

enriched_edge.description: A single enriched topological edge assembled by the compiler. Contains the target's resolved identity, provides, and cascaded annotations.

target.description: The absolute flattened ID of the target node (e.g., 'data-layer.main-db').

socket.description: The usesSchema category this edge belongs to (e.g., 'databases', 'apis').

provides.description: The target node's fully resolved provides dictionary. Evaluated in Pass 1 of Step 5 before inject pre-hydration.

inject.description: The Developer's original inject mapping for this edge (keys = local variable names, values = target provides keys). This is the RAW mapping, not the resolved values.

labels.description: The target node's duck-typing and ontology labels (post-mutation from Step 2).

annotations.description: The target node's three cascading annotation buckets.

release.description: Physical topology strings from the target node's Release boundaries.

catalog.description: Immutable traits from the target node's Catalog entity.

aggregate.description: Cognitive metadata from the target node's Aggregate subsystems.

component.description: The target node's Catalog component type URI (e.g., 'core/postgres').

boundary_path.description: The target node's physical spatial hierarchy from the Release (e.g., 'aws-eks-cluster/backend-ns').

origin_feature.description: If this edge was autonomously declared by a Feature (including credential Features labeled feature.aggrega.ai/kind: secret), the Feature instance name. Null/absent for Developer-declared edges.
